### PDU41002 read-only command set over SERIAL
### firmware 1.3.4 / hardware 1.2 / captured 2026-08-24
### FTDI FT232R /dev/ttyUSB0, 9600 8N1
###
### Format: a "### CMD: <verb>" line, then the response verbatim.
### Serial ECHOES the command, so the echo is the first line of each response.
### The trailing prompt "CyberPower > " is included; it is the read sentinel.

### CMD: sys show
sys show
    Name : PDU-BENCHCTRL
    Location : Office
    Contact : Rick
    Model : PDU41002
    Hardware Version : 1.2
    Firmware Version : 1.3.4
    MAC Address : 00-0C-15-42-29-41

CyberPower >

### CMD: devsta show
### NOTE: Voltage and Frequency are live readings and vary between captures.
### Peak Load and Energy carry parenthesised timestamps, tab-separated.
devsta show

    Load
    -----------------------------------------------
    Device Load : 0.00 A/ 0 W/ 0 VA
    Power Factor : ----
    Peak Load : 0.00A	(at 08/08/2025 19:05:15)
    Energy : 0.0kWh	(from 08/08/2025 19:05:15)

    Utility
    -----------------------------------------------
    Voltage : 122.0V
    Frequency : 60.0Hz

CyberPower >

### CMD: oltsta show
### Column layout: index, name (width ~37), status. Status is trailing-padded.
oltsta show

    #  Name                                 Status
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1  Outlet1                              On
    2  Outlet2                              On
    3  Outlet3                              On
    4  Outlet4                              On
    5  Outlet5                              On
    6  Outlet6                              On
    7  Outlet7                              On
    8  Outlet8                              On

CyberPower >

### CMD: oltsta index 1 show
oltsta index 1 show

    Outlet1
    Outlet Name : Outlet1
    Status :      On

CyberPower >

### CMD: oltcfg index all show
### NOTE: the header wraps onto TWO physical lines ("On/Off/Reboot" then
### "Delay/Delay/Duration"). A line-pair-blind parser will mis-read it.
oltcfg index all show

    #  Name                                    On       Off       Reboot
                                             Delay     Delay     Duration
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1  Outlet1                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    2  Outlet2                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    3  Outlet3                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    4  Outlet4                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    5  Outlet5                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    6  Outlet6                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    7  Outlet7                               3 s        3 s       5 s
    8  Outlet8                               3 s        3 s       5 s

CyberPower >

### CMD: console show
console show
    Console Type :  SSH
    Telnet Port :  23
    SSH Port :  22

CyberPower >

### CMD: snmpv1 show
snmpv1 show
    SNMPv1 : Disable

    Community        IP Address                              Access Type
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    public           0.0.0.0                                 Read Only
    private          0.0.0.0                                 Read/Write
    public2          0.0.0.0                                 Forbidden
    public3          0.0.0.0                                 Forbidden

CyberPower >

### CMD: snmpv3 show
### NOTE: rows here are separated by a bare "\n\r", NOT "\r\n". Preserved as
### captured. Splitting on "\r\n" alone yields one giant row.
snmpv3 show
    SNMPv3 : Disable

    User Name                       Status  IP Address                Auth  Priv
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    snmpv3                          Disable 0.0.0.0                   NONE  NONE
    cyber snmpv3 user2              Disable 0.0.0.0                   NONE  NONE
    cyber snmpv3 user3              Disable 0.0.0.0                   NONE  NONE
    cyber snmpv3 user4              Disable 0.0.0.0                   NONE  NONE

CyberPower >
